unit.title: The Future, Personal Goals and B1 Integration

theory.title: Resolver problemas: verbos modales
theory.explanation: Elige los verbos modales según el significado: should/ought to para aconsejar; must/can't para deducciones firmes; might/could para posibilidades; y modal + be + participio para expresar requisitos en pasiva: The form must be completed (el formulario debe completarse).
theory.tip: Diferencia consejo, deducción y obligación; en pasiva usa modal + be + participio.

patterns.label: Resolver problemas: verbos modales · 1
patterns.pattern: You should check the details before sending the form.
examples:
You should check the details before sending the form.
→ Deberías comprobar los datos antes de enviar el formulario.

patterns.label: Resolver problemas: verbos modales · 2
patterns.pattern: The office must be closed; the lights are off.
examples:
The office must be closed; the lights are off.
→ La oficina debe de estar cerrada; las luces están apagadas.

patterns.label: Resolver problemas: verbos modales · 3
patterns.pattern: The delay might be caused by bad weather.
examples:
The delay might be caused by bad weather.
→ El retraso podría deberse al mal tiempo.

patterns.label: Resolver problemas: verbos modales · 4
patterns.pattern: All applications must be completed online.
examples:
All applications must be completed online.
→ Todas las solicitudes deben completarse en línea.

patterns.label: Resolver problemas: verbos modales · 5
patterns.pattern: You ought to ask for clarification.
examples:
You ought to ask for clarification.
→ Deberías pedir una aclaración.

patterns.label: Resolver problemas: verbos modales · 6
patterns.pattern: The problem can't be serious if it has disappeared.
examples:
The problem can't be serious if it has disappeared.
→ El problema no puede ser grave si ha desaparecido.

patterns.label: Resolver problemas: verbos modales · 7
patterns.pattern: The equipment should be checked regularly.
examples:
The equipment should be checked regularly.
→ El equipo debería revisarse con regularidad.

patterns.label: Resolver problemas: verbos modales · 8
examples:
The meeting may be postponed.
→ Es posible que la reunión se aplace.

patterns.label: Resolver problemas: verbos modales · 9
patterns.pattern: The instructions must be followed carefully.
examples:
The instructions must be followed carefully.
→ Hay que seguir las instrucciones con cuidado.

patterns.label: Resolver problemas: verbos modales · 10
patterns.pattern: You could contact the support team.
examples:
You could contact the support team.
→ Podrías ponerte en contacto con el equipo de asistencia.

content.passage: When the online application system stopped working, the support team investigated the problem. The delay might have been caused by a server update, but the team was not certain. Users should save their work regularly, and all forms must be completed before the deadline. The equipment should be checked every week. The team believes the issue may be resolved by the afternoon, but users could contact support if they need assistance.

items.prompt: Give advice to someone completing an important form.
items.modelAnswer: During this course, I have become more confident using English in everyday situations. I can describe experiences, explain opinions and ask for information more politely. I have also learned how to talk about plans, solve problems and work with other people. Some grammar points were difficult at first, but regular practice helped me improve. In the future, I would like to use English more often at work and when travelling.

content.audioTranscript: A: How have you found the course? B: Very useful. I've developed new skills and gained more confidence. A: What has helped you most? B: The practical experience and regular practice have made a difference. A: Have you shared your opinions in class? B: Yes, and we've solved several problems together. A: What are your plans for the future? B: I want to achieve my goals and continue making progress.
